en: Sepia-toned panoramic view of a European town along a river, seen from an elevated, leafy vantage point. In the foreground is a river with a small weir and a bridge crossing it. The town features clustered houses, factory chimneys, and a prominent hilltop complex with a large tower and castle-like buildings. The caption at the top reads in German: "Zschopau — Blick vom Gensel'schen Park".
